# CUDA Installation Guide for Linux 内容提取报告

**来源**:CUDA Installation Guide for Linux 13.4 documentation(CUDA 13.4 Update 1)

---

## (1) Ubuntu 上安装 CUDA Toolkit 的完整步骤

### ✅ 方式一:Local Repository Installation(正文直接返回,第 4.7.2 节)

> 1. Install local repository on file system:
>
> ```
> # dpkg -i cuda-repo-<distro>-X-Y-local_<version>*_<arch>.deb
> ```
>
> 2. Enroll ephemeral public GPG key:
>
> ```
> # cp /var/cuda-repo-<distro>-X-Y-local/cuda-*-keyring.gpg /usr/share/keyrings/
> ```
>
> 3. Add pin file to prioritize CUDA repository:
>
> ```
> $ wget https://developer.download.nvidia.com/compute/cuda/repos/<distro>/<arch>/cuda-<distro>.pin
> # mv cuda-<distro>.pin /etc/apt/preferences.d/cuda-repository-pin-600
> ```

### ✅ 方式二:Network Repository Installation(正文直接返回,第 4.7.3 节)

> Install the `cuda-keyring` package:
>
> ```
> $ wget https://developer.download.nvidia.com/compute/cuda/repos/<distro>/<arch>/cuda-keyring_1.1-1_all.deb
> # sudo dpkg -i cuda-keyring_1.1-1_all.deb
> ```
>
> ```
> # dpkg -i cuda-keyring_1.1-1_all.deb
> ```

### ✅ Common Installation Instructions(local 和 network 共用,第 4.7.4 节)

> 1. Update the APT repository cache:
>
> ```
> # apt update
> ```
>
> 2. Install CUDA SDK:
>
> **注意:原文注明 "These two commands must be executed separately."**
>
> ```
> # apt install cuda-toolkit
> ```
>
> For native `arm64-sbsa-jetson-openrm` (thor) repositories, install the additional packages:
>
> ```
> # apt install cuda-compat
> ```
>
> For native `arm64-sbsa-jetson-nvgpu` (orin) repositories, install the additional packages:
>
> ```
> # apt install cuda-compat-orin
> ```

### ✅ 方式三:Runfile Installation(正文直接返回,第 6.2 节)

> 1. Perform the pre-installation actions.
> 2. Run the installer and follow the on-screen prompts:
>
> ```
> # sh cuda_<version>_linux.run
> ```
>
> The installer will prompt for the following:
> - EULA Acceptance
> - CUDA Toolkit installation, location, and `/usr/local/cuda` symbolic link
>
> The default installation location for the toolkit is `/usr/local/cuda-13.4`
>
> 3. Reboot the system to reload the graphical interface:
>
> ```
> # reboot
> ```

**Runfile 常用高级选项(第 6.3 节)**:

| 选项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `--toolkitpath=<path>` | 指定 Toolkit 安装路径(默认 `/usr/local/cuda-13.4`) |
| `--override` | 忽略编译器、第三方库和 toolkit 检测检查 |
| `--extract=<path>` | 仅解压原始文件到 `<path>` |
| `--no-man-page` | 不安装 man pages |
| `--tmpdir=<path>` | 自定义临时目录 |
| `--help` | 打印命令行选项列表 |

**Runfile 卸载命令(第 6.4 节)**:

```
# /usr/local/cuda-13.4/bin/cuda-uninstaller
```

# Ubuntu[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/tesla/driver-installation-guide/latest/ubuntu.html#ubuntu "Link to this heading")

[](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/tesla/driver-installation-guide/latest/_images/logo-ubuntu.png)

This section covers:

- Ubuntu 22.04
- Ubuntu 24.04
- Ubuntu 26.04

## Preparation[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/tesla/driver-installation-guide/latest/ubuntu.html#preparation "Link to this heading")

1. Perform the [Pre-installation Actions](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/tesla/driver-installation-guide/latest/pre-installation-actions.html#pre-installation-actions).
2. The kernel headers and development packages for the currently running kernel can be installed with:
   
   ```
   # apt install linux-headers-$(uname -r)
   ```
3. Choose an installation method: [Local Repository Enablement](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/tesla/driver-installation-guide/latest/ubuntu.html#ubuntu-installation-local) or [Network Repository Enablement (amd64)](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/tesla/driver-installation-guide/latest/ubuntu.html#ubuntu-installation-network).

## Local Repository Enablement[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/tesla/driver-installation-guide/latest/ubuntu.html#local-repository-enablement "Link to this heading")

1. Download the NVIDIA driver repository:
   
   ```
   $ wget https://developer.download.nvidia.com/compute/nvidia-driver/<driver-version>/local_installers/nvidia-driver-local-repo-<distribution>-<driver-version>_1.0-1_<arch>.deb
   ```
   
   where `<driver-version>` is the NVIDIA driver version.
2. Install local repository on file system:
   
   ```
   # dpkg -i nvidia-driver-local-repo-<distribution>-<driver-version>_1.0-1_<arch>.deb
   # apt update
   ```
3. Enroll ephemeral public GPG key:
   
   ```
   # cp /var/nvidia-driver-local-repo-<distribution>-<driver-version>/nvidia-driver-*-keyring.gpg /usr/share/keyrings/
   ```

## Network Repository Enablement (amd64)[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/tesla/driver-installation-guide/latest/ubuntu.html#network-repository-enablement-amd64 "Link to this heading")

Install the new cuda-keyring package.

```
$ wget https://developer.download.nvidia.com/compute/cuda/repos/<distribution>/x86_64/cuda-keyring_1.1-1_all.deb
# dpkg -i cuda-keyring_1.1-1_all.deb
# apt update
```

If you are unable to install the `cuda-keyring` package you can follow these instructions:

1. Enroll the new signing key:
   
   ```
   $ wget https://developer.download.nvidia.com/compute/cuda/repos/<distribution>/x86_64/cuda-archive-keyring.gpg
   # mv cuda-archive-keyring.gpg /usr/share/keyrings/cuda-archive-keyring.gpg
   ```
2. Enable the network repository:
   
   ```
   # echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/cuda-archive-keyring.gpg] https://developer.download.nvidia.com/compute/cuda/repos/<distribution>/x86_64/ /" \
       | tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/cuda-<distribution>-<arch>.list
   ```

## Network Repository Enablement (arm64)[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/tesla/driver-installation-guide/latest/ubuntu.html#network-repository-enablement-arm64 "Link to this heading")

Install the new cuda-keyring package.

```
$ wget https://developer.download.nvidia.com/compute/cuda/repos/<distribution>/sbsa/cuda-keyring_1.1-1_all.deb
```

If you are unable to install the `cuda-keyring` package you can follow these instructions:

1. Enroll the new signing key:
   
   ```
   $ wget https://developer.download.nvidia.com/compute/cuda/repos/<distribution>/sbsa/cuda-archive-keyring.gpg
   # mv cuda-archive-keyring.gpg /usr/share/keyrings/cuda-archive-keyring.gpg
   ```
2. Enable the network repository:
   
   ```
   # echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/cuda-archive-keyring.gpg] https://developer.download.nvidia.com/compute/cuda/repos/<distribution>/sbsa/ /" \
       | tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/cuda-<distribution>-<arch>.list
   ```

## Selecting a Branch or a Specific Driver version[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/tesla/driver-installation-guide/latest/ubuntu.html#selecting-a-branch-or-a-specific-driver-version "Link to this heading")

To confine and pin the system to track a specific branch or driver version, install the appropriate pinning package, for example:

```
# apt install nvidia-driver-pinning-<branch>
```

or

```
# apt install nvidia-driver-pinning-<version>
```

Hint

For the best experience when locking a branch, we suggest installing the pinning package prior to installing the driver.

More information on the use and scope of these packages can be found in the recent updates section on [Version locking packages for Ubuntu / Debian](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/tesla/driver-installation-guide/latest/recent-updates.html#recent-updates-pinning) and explained in detail at [Version locking](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/tesla/driver-installation-guide/latest/version-locking.html#version-lock).

Warning

Starting with branch 590, the Ubuntu packages have been renamed by removing the branch designation from the package name. Switching branches, installing specific driver versions and specific upgrade / downgrade requirements will be supported through these version locking (pinning) packages.

Please refer to the [Ubuntu 590 and later packages](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/tesla/driver-installation-guide/latest/recent-updates.html#recent-updates-ubuntu-590) section of the recent updates for more information.

## Driver Installation[#](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/tesla/driver-installation-guide/latest/ubuntu.html#driver-installation "Link to this heading")

These instructions apply to both local and network installations.

**Open Kernel Modules**

```

# Ubuntu 从零安装 CUDA Toolkit 及环境变量配置

## 一、版本与支持矩阵（已核实）

- 当前 CUDA 版本：**13.4 Update 1（13.4.1）**，官方指南 https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/cuda-installation-guide-linux/
- 支持的 Ubuntu：22.04 LTS、24.04 LTS、26.04 LTS（x86_64 与 arm64 SBSA）
- **重要变更（官方原文）**："Starting with CUDA 13.4, the CUDA Toolkit and the NVIDIA driver are installed and versioned independently. The recommended `cuda-toolkit` meta package installs the toolkit only and does **not** install a driver." —— 驱动需单独安装（`nvidia-open` / `cuda-drivers` 归属驱动侧，Table 6）。

## 二、安装步骤（官方 network repo 方式，推荐）

```bash
# 1. 添加 NVIDIA 仓库（<distro> 取 ubuntu2204 / ubuntu2404 / ubuntu2604）
wget https://developer.download.nvidia.com/compute/cuda/repos/<distro>/<arch>/cuda-keyring_1.1-1_all.deb
sudo dpkg -i cuda-keyring_1.1-1_all.deb

# 2. 安装驱动（CUDA 13.4 起独立于 toolkit；官方 Driver Installation Guide, Ubuntu 章节）
sudo apt install linux-headers-$(uname -r)
sudo apt update
sudo apt install nvidia-open        # Open Kernel Modules；旧分支可用 cuda-drivers（proprietary）

# 3. 安装 toolkit（官方 4.7.4 节；注意官方注明两条命令须分开执行）
sudo apt update
sudo apt install cuda-toolkit

sudo reboot
```

其他方式：local repo（`dpkg -i cuda-repo-<distro>-X-Y-local_*.deb` + 复制 keyring.gpg + pin 文件）；runfile（`sudo sh cuda_<version>_linux.run`，默认装到 `/usr/local/cuda-13.4` 并建 `/usr/local/cuda` 符号链接，可 `--toolkitpath=` 改路径、`--override` 跳过检查）。来源均为上述官方指南正文。

## 三、环境变量配置（PATH / LD_LIBRARY_PATH）

官方指南设有 "Post-installation Actions" 章节规定环境变量设置，但**该章节正文因工具截断未能逐字取回原文**（多次获取均在第 8.3/10.1 节处被截断，属"未取得"而非不存在；原因：页面过长超出工具返回上限）。以下内容依据检索前知识 + 二手来源（博客园，2025-09-12，https://www.cnblogs.com/mistsly/p/19088376）交叉印证，写入 `~/.bashrc`：

```bash
export PATH=/usr/local/cuda/bin:$PATH
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/cuda/lib64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH
# 可选
export CUDA_HOME=/usr/local/cuda
```

`/usr/local/cuda` 是指向 `/usr/local/cuda-13.4` 的符号链接；多版本并存时可写版本化路径如 `/usr/local/cuda-13.4/bin` 与 `/usr/local/cuda-13.4/lib64`。官方推荐的防重复写法为 `export PATH=/usr/local/cuda-13.4/bin${PATH:+:${PATH}}` 和 `export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/cuda-13.4/lib64${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH}}`（此逐字形式来自检索前知识，**本轮未能从官方正文核实**）。

说明：deb/apt 方式安装时库通常已由 ldconfig 注册，`LD_LIBRARY_PATH` 常非必需；runfile 安装或自定义路径时需要。配置后 `source ~/.bashrc`，用 `nvcc --version` 与 `nvidia-smi` 验证。

</answer>

# Ubuntu 从零安装 CUDA Toolkit 及环境变量配置

## 一、版本与支持矩阵（已核实）

- 当前 CUDA 版本：**13.4 Update 1（13.4.1）**，官方指南 https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/cuda-installation-guide-linux/
- 支持的 Ubuntu：22.04 LTS、24.04 LTS、26.04 LTS（x86_64 与 arm64 SBSA）
- **重要变更（官方原文）**："Starting with CUDA 13.4, the CUDA Toolkit and the NVIDIA driver are installed and versioned independently. The recommended `cuda-toolkit` meta package installs the toolkit only and does **not** install a driver." —— 驱动需单独安装（`nvidia-open` / `cuda-drivers` 归属驱动侧，Table 6）。

## 二、安装步骤（官方 network repo 方式，推荐）

```bash
# 1. 添加 NVIDIA 仓库（<distro> 取 ubuntu2204 / ubuntu2404 / ubuntu2604）
wget https://developer.download.nvidia.com/compute/cuda/repos/<distro>/<arch>/cuda-keyring_1.1-1_all.deb
sudo dpkg -i cuda-keyring_1.1-1_all.deb

# 2. 安装驱动（CUDA 13.4 起独立于 toolkit；官方 Driver Installation Guide, Ubuntu 章节）
sudo apt install linux-headers-$(uname -r)
sudo apt update
sudo apt install nvidia-open        # Open Kernel Modules；旧分支可用 cuda-drivers（proprietary）

# 3. 安装 toolkit（官方 4.7.4 节；注意官方注明两条命令须分开执行）
sudo apt update
sudo apt install cuda-toolkit

sudo reboot
```

其他方式：local repo（`dpkg -i cuda-repo-<distro>-X-Y-local_*.deb` + 复制 keyring.gpg + pin 文件）；runfile（`sudo sh cuda_<version>_linux.run`，默认装到 `/usr/local/cuda-13.4` 并建 `/usr/local/cuda` 符号链接，可 `--toolkitpath=` 改路径、`--override` 跳过检查）。来源均为上述官方指南正文。

## 三、环境变量配置（PATH / LD_LIBRARY_PATH）

官方指南设有 "Post-installation Actions" 章节规定环境变量设置，但**该章节正文因工具截断未能逐字取回原文**（多次获取均在第 8.3/10.1 节处被截断，属"未取得"而非不存在；原因：页面过长超出工具返回上限）。以下内容依据检索前知识 + 二手来源（博客园，2025-09-12，https://www.cnblogs.com/mistsly/p/19088376）交叉印证，写入 `~/.bashrc`：

```bash
export PATH=/usr/local/cuda/bin:$PATH
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/cuda/lib64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH
# 可选
export CUDA_HOME=/usr/local/cuda
```

`/usr/local/cuda` 是指向 `/usr/local/cuda-13.4` 的符号链接；多版本并存时可写版本化路径如 `/usr/local/cuda-13.4/bin` 与 `/usr/local/cuda-13.4/lib64`。官方推荐的防重复写法为 `export PATH=/usr/local/cuda-13.4/bin${PATH:+:${PATH}}` 和 `export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/cuda-13.4/lib64${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH}}`（此逐字形式来自检索前知识，**本轮未能从官方正文核实**）。

说明：deb/apt 方式安装时库通常已由 ldconfig 注册，`LD_LIBRARY_PATH` 常非必需；runfile 安装或自定义路径时需要。配置后 `source ~/.bashrc`，用 `nvcc --version` 与 `nvidia-smi` 验证。

1. 官方 Post-installation Actions 章节的逐字原文（工具截断，未取回）。

3. 当前驱动分支号：驱动指南标题称 branch 615，正文 warning 提及 branch 590 起包名变更，具体最新版本号未进一步核实。
